# Grid selection models tell rows from cells by string and by ntype

## Context

Split from #9075 with @tobiu's approval (option A, 2026-09-14). The PR resolving #9075 narrows it to what the intake evidence showed was broken and shippable: column selection that never repainted its cells, the three drifted copies of that logic, and a row or column highlight surviving a model swap-out. This ticket carries #9075's remaining objectives, **reshaped by the [intake finding](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/9075#issuecomment-5668978579)**, because two of them were prescribed with mechanisms that do not fit the code as it stands.

## The Problem

`src/selection/grid` still tells its item kinds apart by string, and its class hierarchy still forces duplication:

1. **Row versus cell, by string.** `BaseModel#updateBodyRows` decides per item with `item.toString().includes('__')` (`BaseModel.mjs:98`): a logical cell id is `recordId__dataField`, a record id is not. The branch is load-bearing — one `CellRowModel` instance feeds record ids (`selectRow` / `deselectRow` → `updateRows(recordId)`) *and* logical cell ids (`CellModel#onCellClick` → `toggleSelection`) through the same method. By construction the predicate cannot distinguish a record whose key itself contains `__`. #9012 already gave rows and cells `data-record-id` / `data-field` attributes so selection code need not reverse-engineer ids; this branch predates using them here.
2. **Row-selecting models, by ntype.** `View#rowSelectionModel` (`View.mjs:126–129`) recognises a row-selecting model by `selectionModel?.ntype?.includes('row')`, and both the flag adoption and the paint getters read it. #18626 deferred "a declared row-selection trait on the model classes" to #9075.
3. **Duplication the hierarchy forces.** After #9075's dedupe, `CellColumnModel` and `CellColumnRowModel` still carry two identical overrides (`onCellClick`, `onNavKeyColumn`) because they extend different parents (`CellModel` / `CellRowModel`). Neo's mixins cannot host them: `mixinProperty` (`Neo.mjs:1184`) assigns over the class's own method, and a copied method keeps its home object, so `super` inside it resolves against the mixin's parent.
4. **`internalId` versus `recordId` handling**, #9075's fourth objective, written in 2026-02 — before #18661 made the View own the single model. Whether it still applies is unverified.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/selection/grid/BaseModel.mjs` — `updateRows` / `updateBodyRows`; `selectRow` / `deselectRow` / `deselectAllRows`; `select` / `deselect` / `deselectAll`; and the column half added by #9075's PR (`setSelectedColumns`, `updateColumns`, `stepSelectedColumn`).
- `src/selection/grid/{RowModel,CellModel,CellRowModel,CellColumnModel,CellColumnRowModel,ColumnModel}.mjs`.
- `src/grid/View.mjs` — `rowSelectionModel` and its consumers: the flag adoption on store bind/load, and the paint getters.
- `src/grid/Row.mjs` — renders row, cell and column selection state from the View's model; `grid/Body.mjs#fireCellEvent` resolves `dataField` / `record` from the `data-*` attributes.

## The Fix

1. **Type the updates where the caller knows the type.** The row callers — `selectRow`, `deselectRow`, `deselectAllRows` — always pass record ids. The generic `select` / `deselect` / `deselectAll` pass the model's own items. `updateBodyRows` stops inspecting strings.
2. **Declare the trait.** A row-selecting model says so on its class; `View#rowSelectionModel` reads that instead of an ntype substring.
3. **Compose the column-selecting Cell\* pair** without relying on `super` inside a mixin — or record, with evidence, that two small overrides are the right shape for two parents.
4. **Verify objective 4 at intake** against the post-#18661 code; normalize with an arm, or close it out as already done.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1 `BaseModel#updateBodyRows` inspects no item strings; row and cell repaints are typed at the call site; a record whose key contains `__` repaints as a row.
- [ ] AC-2 `View#rowSelectionModel` reads a declared trait; no `ntype` substring test remains. The flag-following arms in `ViewOwnedSelectionModel.spec.mjs` stay green for `RowModel`, `CellRowModel` and `CellColumnRowModel`, and stay off for `CellModel` and `ColumnModel`.
- [ ] AC-3 `CellColumnModel` and `CellColumnRowModel` carry no duplicated override — or this ticket records why two overrides are the right shape.
- [ ] AC-4 `internalId` / `recordId` handling is verified at intake: normalized with an arm, or closed out with the evidence that it already is.
- [ ] AC-5 `unit/grid/ColumnSelection.spec.mjs` and `ViewOwnedSelectionModel.spec.mjs` stay green.

## Additional intake evidence from the six-model review

The [#18708 review](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/18708#pullrequestreview-5202539790) checked every concrete grid selection model. One **pre-existing hierarchy defect** belongs in the remaining row-model work: `CellRowModel` and `CellColumnRowModel` call `this.updateAnnotations(record)` for a declared selected-record field, but neither inherits that method. It exists on `RowModel`; their chain is `CellColumnRowModel → CellRowModel → CellModel → BaseModel → Model`.

Reproduced at both parent `d8e13f46d0e10519603bf60daaf13acb0a5d03fa` and PR head `ce1c783390680b5f5faa64755071c2d92fec2463`, using real App-worker grid instances: Store with a Boolean `flag` field, View `selectedRecordField:'flag'`, then `model.onCellClick({record:store.get('r3'), dataField:'col2'})`. Both combined row models report `hasAnnotations(record) === true`, `typeof model.updateAnnotations === 'undefined'`, and throw `TypeError: me.updateAnnotations is not a function`. RowModel's corresponding row-click handler is the positive control: it sets the flag and selects the record.

The existing flag-following tests exercise **store → selection**; they do not exercise this **gesture → record flag → selection** direction. Include that direction when revalidating the row-selection contract. This is not a third Required Action on #18708, and no new ticket is needed.

The same review found a real numeric-business-key DOM event/resolver failure relevant to AC-4; its delivered-click correction is RA-2 on #18708, so recheck the repaired parent before duplicating that work here. CellRowModel's pre-existing split-row DOM flush gap remains within #9492; the new CellColumnRowModel regression is RA-1 on #18708.
